title: Can different wheel sizes be loaded together? Supporting requirements for a three-level roller-hearth line
summary: A Suneng discussion draft for continuous wheel heat treatment proposes basket-free, three-level roller-hearth transport, mixed-size feeding and an alignment mechanism at each discharge level. Assessing suitability requires tracing feed arrangement, transfer between levels, immersion after heating, water draining and entry to the ageing furnace. Nominal row counts alone do not establish actual capacity.
